rationale: Empty box boundary (1px #767676 vs white = 4.5:1) passes at rest. In the checked state a #7fb0ee fill appears and the white tick that conveys 'checked' abuts that fill at 2.247:1, below 3:1. The cue only fails in the active (checked) state.
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11: 'The visual presentation of the following have a contrast ratio of at least 3:1 against adjacent color(s): ... User Interface Components: Visual information required to identify user interface components and states'. The requirement applies in each state the content can be in; measured against the adjacent fill, not the page.

rationale: The selected-tab underline is the sole non-text cue identifying the active tab. It abuts the #5a8fe0 tab strip (not the page): #8ab4f8 on #5a8fe0 = 1.547:1, below 3:1.
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11: contrast '... against adjacent color(s) ... Visual information required to identify ... states'. Trusted Tester 5.1: non-text contrast of UI component states/boundaries. Adjacent color is the strip the underline touches.

rationale: At rest the border (#595959 vs #e8e8e8 = 5.7:1) passes. The pressed state is conveyed only by a border-color change; in :active the border becomes #b0b0b0 against the same #e8e8e8 button face = 1.770:1, below 3:1, so the pressed boundary is indistinct.
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11: 'Visual information required to identify ... states'. The requirement applies in each state the content can be in; adjacent color is the button surface the border abuts.

rationale: The disclosure chevron is the expanded-state indicator. In the open state it sits on the tinted header/panel (#dce8fb): #a8c4ec = 1.442:1, below 3:1. Measured against the open-panel surface it abuts, not the page.
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11: contrast '... against adjacent color(s)' for 'Visual information required to identify ... states'. Applies in the expanded state.

rationale: aria-current marks the current page; its only non-text cue is a dot under the link, abutting the #5a8fe0 nav strip. #9bb8ec on #5a8fe0 = 1.624:1, below 3:1.
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11: 'Visual information required to identify ... states ... against adjacent color(s)'. The current state's indicator is measured against the nav strip it touches.

rationale: The focus state is conveyed only by a custom ring (UA outline removed). The ring #aaaaaa against the white page it abuts = 2.323:1, below the 3:1 needed for a visible focus indicator.
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 (states) and Technique G195 (visible focus indicator with sufficient contrast). Focus is a state; the focus indicator must reach 3:1 against adjacent color.

rationale: In the ON (checked) state the knob (#d4e2fb) abuts the ON track (#9fc0f5) at 1.418:1. The knob boundary that conveys the on-state is indistinct against the surface it touches.
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11: 'Visual information required to identify ... states ... against adjacent color(s)'. Adjacent color is the track the knob abuts in the on-state.

rationale: The dark box boundary passes, but the checkmark cue conveying the checked state is #969696 on the white box interior = 2.958:1, just below 3:1 (3:1 is inclusive, so 2.958 fails).
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11: at least 3:1 against adjacent color(s) for visual information that identifies states. 3:1 is the inclusive threshold.

rationale: Only the selected (active) state introduces a visible indicator (a ring); no checkmark, fill, or border-color change. That sole indicator is #c9d8f2 on the white page = 1.440:1, far below 3:1.
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11: 'Visual information required to identify ... states ... against adjacent color(s)'. When the active state is the only one that introduces a cue, that cue must reach 3:1.

rationale: The checked tick is 25%-opacity black; composited over the white box interior it renders #bfbfbf = 1.839:1 against white. The alpha hides a sub-threshold cue; contrast must use the composited color.
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11: at least 3:1 against adjacent color(s). Contrast is computed on the rendered (composited) color of the state indicator.

rationale: The ON-knob (#767676) clears 3:1 against the white PAGE (4.542:1) but sits inside a dark #5e5e5e card on a dark track. Against the adjacent #5e5e5e surface it actually abuts = 1.428:1, a failure. The page color is a decoy; 1.4.11 is measured against adjacent color(s).
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11: '... a contrast ratio of at least 3:1 against adjacent color(s)'. Adjacent means the surface the indicator touches, not the page background.

rationale: The checked fill (#1a73e8) passes against the page, but the half-opacity white tick composites to #8db9f4 over that fill = 2.226:1, below 3:1. The cue ON the fill is sub-threshold even though the fill itself is fine.
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11: at least 3:1 against adjacent color(s) for visual information identifying states. The tick is measured against the fill it abuts, using the composited color.

rationale: The checked white tick sits on a blue gradient (#7fb0ee to #1a73e8). A flat-color reducer cannot resolve a single adjacent surface and should abstain. Human truth: over the light end (#7fb0ee) the white tick is 2.247:1, a real failure, so the case is a positive.
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11: at least 3:1 against adjacent color(s). A flat-color reducer must bail on gradient/photographic adjacent surfaces (abstain); the human-judged truth here is a failure at the light end.

rationale: Rest boundary 7:1; in the checked state the white tick on a strong #1a73e8 fill = 4.505:1. The state indicator passes in every state.
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11: at least 3:1 against adjacent color(s) for states. Both rest and checked states clear 3:1.

rationale: The checked checkmark is #909090 on the white box interior = 3.193:1, just above 3:1. Since 3:1 is inclusive, it passes.
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11: a contrast ratio of at least 3:1. 3:1 is inclusive; 3.193 passes.

rationale: The dark #2b2b2b page is a decoy. The ON-track (#1a73e8) abuts the white card = 4.505:1 and the white knob abuts the ON-track = 4.505:1. Measured against the true adjacent surfaces, the indicator passes.
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11: '... at least 3:1 against adjacent color(s)'. Adjacent means the card/track the indicator touches, not the page.

rationale: Although the on-knob (#d4e2fb) vs the on-track (#9fc0f5) is only 1.418:1, the switch is disabled (aria-disabled / native disabled). SC 1.4.11 exempts inactive components, so a low-contrast indicator on a disabled control is not a barrier.
citation: Understanding SC 1.4.11 Exceptions: 'Inactive: ... a component that is not available ... is not required to meet the contrast requirements.' The component is inactive (disabled), so exempt.

rationale: The checked radio dot and checkbox tick are rendered by the user agent with no author styling (no appearance/accent-color/custom indicator). Their appearance is UA-determined and not modified by the author, so they are exempt.
citation: Understanding SC 1.4.11 Exceptions: 'User Agent control ... default rendering ... is not author-modified and is exempt.' Also the SC text: 'except for ... where the appearance ... is determined by the user agent and not modified by the author.'

rationale: The pale swatch fills are essential (they ARE the color being chosen, so their exact contrast is the content). The selected state is conveyed by a separate, color-independent #595959 ring at 7.005:1 against the page, which passes. No barrier.
citation: Understanding SC 1.4.11 Exceptions: 'Essential: A particular presentation ... is essential.' The selection state is additionally carried by a sufficient ring (7.005:1).

rationale: In the ON state the white knob abuts the #1a73e8 track at 4.505:1 and the track vs the page is 4.505:1. The toggle's state indicator passes.
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11: at least 3:1 against adjacent color(s) for states. The on-state knob/track contrast clears 3:1.

rationale: The expanded-state chevron (#3367d6) on the open panel (#dce8fb) it abuts = 4.190:1, above 3:1. The expanded indicator passes.
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11: at least 3:1 against adjacent color(s) for states. Measured against the open-panel surface.

rationale: In the pressed (:active) state the border is #595959 on the #e8e8e8 pressed surface = 5.717:1, well above 3:1. The pressed boundary is clear.
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11: at least 3:1 against adjacent color(s) for states. The pressed border vs its surface clears 3:1.

rationale: The custom focus ring is #1a73e8 against the white page it abuts = 4.505:1, above 3:1, satisfying the focus-indicator contrast.
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 (states) and Technique G195 (visible focus indicator with sufficient contrast). The focus state's ring clears 3:1.

rationale: The checked state is identified by the blue fill plus the white tick (4.505:1, passes). A faint #e3e3e3 outer glow (1.283:1) is a redundant decorative accent that is NOT required to identify the state, so its low contrast is out of scope.
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 applies to 'Visual information required to identify ... states'. A decorative cue not required to identify the state is out of scope when a sufficient primary cue (white tick, 4.505:1) exists.

rationale: The selected-tab underline is white on the #1a73e8 strip it abuts = 4.505:1, above 3:1. The selected indicator passes.
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11: at least 3:1 against adjacent color(s) for states. Measured against the strip the underline touches.

rationale: The checked dark #1a1a1a tick sits on a blue gradient (#7fb0ee to #1a73e8). A flat-color reducer cannot resolve a single adjacent surface and should abstain. Human truth: the dark tick clears 3:1 against both stops (7.747:1 light end, 3.863:1 dark end), so it passes everywhere; the case is a negative.
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11: at least 3:1 against adjacent color(s). A flat-color reducer must bail on gradient adjacent surfaces (abstain); the human-judged truth here is a pass across the whole gradient (worst case 3.863:1).
